title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Genesis 7: Noah enters the ship, the rain comes, and the waters cover the earth.

questions.text: How many of every clean animal did Yahweh tell Noah to take?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Noah to take seven pairs of every clean animal, and two of the animals that are not clean.

questions.text: How long did Yahweh say He would cause it to rain on the earth?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that in seven days he would cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights.

questions.text: How old was Noah when the flood came on the earth?
questions.explanation: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

questions.text: On what date in Noah's six hundredth year did the sky's windows open?
questions.explanation: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the fountains of the deep burst open and the sky's windows opened.

answers.text: The first day of the first month
The tenth day of the seventh month
The seventeenth day of the second month
The last day of the twelfth month

questions.text: Besides the sky's windows opening, what burst open on that day?
questions.explanation: On that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky's windows opened.

answers.text: All the fountains of the great deep

questions.text: What were the names of Noah's sons who entered the ship?
questions.explanation: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, Noah's wife and the three wives of his sons entered the ship.

questions.text: Who shut Noah in the ship?
questions.explanation: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.

questions.text: According to verse 20, how many cubits higher did the waters rise?
questions.explanation: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

questions.text: Who was left alive after every living thing on the ground was destroyed?
questions.explanation: Every living thing on the surface of the ground was destroyed. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

answers.text: Only Noah and those with him in the ship
Noah and the people on the mountains
Only the birds of the sky

questions.text: According to the last verse, how long did the waters flood the earth?
questions.explanation: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.
